evals.name: full-policy-direct-write
evals.description: A complete governance policy is written directly without unnecessary questions.
evals.prompt: In a btp-iac project, establish governance: allow eu10 and eu20, forbid us10, keep customer data in the EU for GDPR, and prefer eu10. Subaccounts use {org}-{env}-{app}, where org is the organisation short code, env is dev/test/prod, and app is the application identifier; use a hierarchical directory structure and a maximum name length of 60. In dev, permit free and standard, forbid none, and default to free. In test, permit standard, forbid none, and default to standard. In prod, permit standard, forbid free because it has no SLA, and default to standard. Require a SAML 2.0 custom IdP; assign BTP_OPERATOR to platform-admins and BTP_VIEWER to developers at both scopes; allow internal systems only with OAuth2ClientCredentials destinations. Enable warnings for hana-cloud and ai-core, require the cost_center tag.
evals.trap: The prompt deliberately provides all five categories. The skill must not ask redundant follow-up questions, invent an Override flag, or omit required fields that happen to have a value such as 'none'.

assertions.text: Does not ask any follow-up governance questions before writing the file
Creates memory/governance.md at the located project root with Regions, Naming, Service Plans, Security, and Cost Controls sections
Preserves the supplied region, naming, per-environment plan, security, and cost-control values in their required labelled fields
Includes separate dev and prod Service Plans subsections, each with Permitted, Forbidden, Default plan, and a Forbidden reason when one was supplied
The generated memory/governance.md artifact does not contain '- Override: true'
Confirms governance.md was saved and summarizes all five rule categories plus the downstream commands that enforce them

evals.name: partial-policy-ask-only-missing
evals.description: Only uncovered governance categories receive one targeted question.

turns.content: In this btp-iac project, only eu10 is approved; us10 is forbidden; data must remain in the EU for GDPR; prefer eu10. Use {org}-{env}-{app}, where org is our short code, env is dev/test/prod, and app is the app identifier; use a flat directory structure and names up to 60 characters. Require an OIDC custom IdP, assign BTP_OPERATOR to platform-admins at platform scope, permit internal destinations only, and require OAuth2ClientCredentials.

For service plans, dev may use free (default free), test may use standard (default standard), and prod may use standard (default standard); free is forbidden in prod because it has no SLA. Enable metered-service warnings for hana-cloud and ai-core. The cost centre tag is required and its Terraform key is cost_center.

evals.trap: Regions, Naming, and Security are complete. Asking about any of those again violates the command contract; the file must not be written until service-plan and cost-control information has been collected.

assertions.text: Requests only the missing Service Plans details, covering permitted plans, forbidden plans and reasons, and defaults per environment
Requests only the missing Cost Controls details, covering metered-service warnings and the cost-centre tag
Does not ask a Regions, Naming, or Security question
Does not create or overwrite memory/governance.md before the missing answers are supplied
After the second user turn, writes a complete structured governance file retaining the initially supplied rules and adding the supplied Service Plans and Cost Controls rules
Confirms the saved governance file and summarizes all five categories after the second user turn

evals.name: empty-policy-five-questions
evals.description: A bare invocation initiates complete governance discovery without writing a partial policy.
evals.prompt: Set up governance for this btp-iac project.
evals.trap: No governance details were supplied. The skill must ask one question per category, one at a time, rather than batch all five into a single tool call or manufacture defaults or write a skeletal file.

assertions.text: Requests the Regions details: approved and forbidden regions, data residency, compliance reason, and preferred default
Requests the Naming details: pattern, token meanings, environment tiers, directory structure, and length limit
Requests the Service Plans details: permitted and forbidden plans, reasons, and defaults per environment
Requests the Security details: IdP, role collections and scope, destination restrictions, and authentication type
Requests the Cost Controls details: metered-service warning policy and cost-centre tag requirements
Asks exactly one category question per turn, waits for the answer, then asks the next — never bundles multiple categories into a single question or tool call
Does not create or overwrite memory/governance.md until all required information is collected

evals.name: no-project-root-safe-failure
evals.description: The skill safely refuses to operate when no btp-iac project root is an ancestor.
evals.prompt: From a directory with no ancestor containing specs/, memory/, and terraform/, establish governance allowing eu10 only.
evals.trap: The requested rule is intentionally sufficient to tempt a write, but no valid project root exists.

assertions.text: Stops and communicates that no btp-iac project root was found, and that the command must run within a project created by btp-iac init
Does not create, modify, or propose creating any governance file or directory
Does not continue by asking governance-category questions

evals.name: existing-governance-done-preserves-file
evals.description: An existing policy is reviewed and remains unchanged when the user chooses done.

files.content:
# BTP Governance

## Regions
- Allowed: eu10, eu20
- Forbidden: us10
- Data residency: EU only
- Compliance reason: GDPR
- Preferred region: eu10

## Naming
- Subaccount pattern: {org}-{env}-{app}
- Pattern tokens: {org} = organisation, {env} = environment, {app} = application
- Environments: dev, prod
- Directory structure: flat
- Max name length: 60

## Service Plans
### dev
- Permitted: free
- Forbidden: none
- Default plan: free
### prod
- Permitted: standard
- Forbidden: free
- Forbidden reason: no SLA
- Default plan: standard

## Security
- Custom IdP: required
- IdP type: OIDC
- Default role collections: BTP_OPERATOR → platform-admins
- Role collection scope: platform
- Destinations: internal systems only
- Destination auth type: OAuth2ClientCredentials

## Cost Controls
- Metered service warning: enabled
- Metered services: hana-cloud
- Cost centre tag: required
- Tag key name: cost_center

evals.trap: The existing file takes precedence over a fresh discovery workflow. A response of done must not normalize, regenerate, or otherwise rewrite it.

assertions.text: Reads the existing memory/governance.md and displays a summary grouped by governance category
Asks: Here are the current governance rules. What would you like to change, or type 'done' to keep them as-is.
After the user responds done, stops without asking new category questions
The initial_artifacts and artifacts values for memory/governance.md are byte-for-byte identical

evals.name: override-is-explicit-only
evals.description: Override is emitted only when the user expressly requests weaker enforcement.
evals.prompt: In a btp-iac project, establish a complete governance policy using eu10 only; use {org}-{env}-{app}, where org is the organisation short code, env is the environment tier, and app is the application identifier, for dev and prod in a flat structure with 60-character names; permit standard plans and default standard for each environment, with no forbidden plans; do not require a custom IdP, use N/A, assign no default role collections at platform scope, permit unrestricted destinations with any authentication; disable metered-service warnings, use all as the metered-services value, and make the cost_center tag optional. Explicitly add Override: true because this project needs warnings instead of hard blocks.
evals.trap: Override is a powerful exception. The skill must add it when directly requested, but must not treat any ordinary full-policy prompt as authorization to add it.

assertions.text: Writes a complete governance file containing a top-level '- Override: true' entry because the user explicitly requested it
Preserves the supplied normal governance rules instead of replacing them with override-only content
Explains that Override changes downstream violations from hard blocks to warnings

evals.description: A requested change to an existing policy is merged without clobbering unrelated rules.
